description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top two cards of your library, including Blood Pet, with the ability to cast them until your next turn.
Cast Blood Pet from exile by paying {B}.
Repeat.
